_comment: SD pre-reduce EWL — 10-epoch DIAGNOSTIC smoke (staged-cadence: smoke before any >=1h arm).
Purpose is NOT a verdict: it answers the one open question from the first ON run, which
built ZERO rows and attributed 5041 skips to 'immature arc' and 4274 to 'missing ambiguity
column' — does the detector hold an MW arc on the (band2, band5) EWL pair at all?
min_arc_epochs is dropped to 2 so a 10-epoch run can reach maturity; that is a DIAGNOSTIC
setting, not the shipping one (the 0.05 m sigma floor still bounds a 2-sample row's
information).  network.sd_ewl.trace writes logs/network_sd_ewl.csv — one row per
(station, epoch, satellite) with the ELECTED signal pair, its code channels, and the
outcome, so 'no such arc' and 'arc too young' are distinguishable per satellite.
Read: the run-end 'Network (SD pre-reduce EWL)' line (sat_seen vs skip_no_arc vs
skip_immature vs skip_missing_amb_col) and the status column of network_sd_ewl.csv.
